items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Well Sonny Berman, you know was with Woody’s First Herd, and he was – not the band that played the blues but the, you know the first Bill Harris band, that band that…

We used to call the, Wild Root band, you know, had the Wild Root commercial radio show at that time. And it was the first big Woody Herman band that was really happening, you know, “Your Father’s Moustache,”, “Northwest Passage,”, “Caldonia,” band.
